**Source** [GM Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=218) pg. 281 **Usage** held in 1 hand **Bulk** 1 --- This twisted and grim-looking staff is adorned with hideous skull and bone motifs. Creatures summoned using this staff gain a number of temporary Hit Points equal to the level of the spell used to summon them. **Activate** Cast a Spell; **Effect** You expend a number of charges from the staff to cast a spell from its list. **Craft Requirements** Supply one casting of all listed ranks of all listed spells. Staff of the Dead **Source** [GM Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=218) pg. 281 **Price** 230 gp ---
  • **Cantrip** [_void warp_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1745)
  • **1st** [_grim tendrils_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1548), [_summon undead_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1706)
  • **2nd** [_peaceful rest_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1625), summon undead
Staff of the Dead (Greater) **Source** [GM Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=218) pg. 281 **Price** 900 gp ---
  • **3rd** summon undead, [_vampiric feast_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1736)
  • **4th** summon undead, [_vision of death_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1742)
Staff of the Dead (Major) **Source** [GM Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=218) pg. 281 **Price** 4,000 gp ---
  • **5th** [_invoke spirits_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1578), peaceful rest, summon undead
  • **6th** summon undead, [_vampiric exsanguination_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1735)
name: Staff of the Dead (Greater)
